# TokenShade

> Stop the burn on your plan.

TokenShade is an independent, open-source orchestration policy for coding
agents. It groups independent, already-known tool calls, preserves sequential
work when order matters, and discourages repetitive polling. It is Codex-first
with a one-session prompt for ChatGPT Work and portable Claude Code, Kimi Code
CLI, and agent-neutral instruction files. Ordinary ChatGPT chats without agent
tools have nothing to batch; the benchmark claim is Codex-only.

## One-tweet prompt

Batch 2+ independent, already-known tool calls in one concurrent stage; inspect every result. Keep dependencies, exploration, approvals, conflicting writes, waits, and resumes sequential. For long commands, wait meaningfully before polling. Never invent work just to batch.

- Security: https://github.com/frizas/tokenshade/blob/main/SECURITY.md

TokenShade is not affiliated with OpenAI. Benchmark claims are workload-specific.
